events.title: Pisgah Rage Pre-season
events.description: Runs 15 Oct 2026 to 15 Dec 2026. Pre-season activities including social events, rider assessment, bike shop night, parent meeting, and adventure rides in Bent Creek or Dupont

events.title: Pisgah Rage Regular Season
events.description: Runs 1 Dec 2026 to 30 May 2027. Regular season with indoor training January, weekend practices February-May, and 5-6 races across North Carolina starting in early March
events.venue: Asheville area and across North Carolina
